assumptions.text: The capacity append chooses when it grows is not modelled: a grown append's backing is fresh and its capacity is ["unknown", "growth"].
errors.New and fmt.Errorf return non-nil errors, and so does a package variable of an error type that the package initializer assigns from one of them.
Nil pointer dereferences are not partiality sites.
Calls outside the analyzed packages that are not primitives are opaque: their results are call terms, and what they do to memory they can reach is unknown.
BytesToHash(b) is the 32-byte array holding b right-aligned (common/types.go: SetBytes crops b to its last 32 bytes, then copies it to h[32-len(b):]); for len(b) == 32 element k is b[k].
Keccak256Hash(data...) is the keccak-256 digest of the concatenated arguments: an opaque HASH sink; it reads its arguments and retains none of them.
